title: 分别观察取消类别与原因
code:
func Example_withCancelCause() {
	cause := errors.New("caller stopped waiting")
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancelCause(context.Background())
	defer cancel(nil)
	cancel(cause)
	fmt.Println(ctx.Err())
	fmt.Println(context.Cause(ctx))
}
